_comment: COPY THIS to $PROFILE_DIR/profile.json and edit. Do NOT edit it in place and do NOT put your
real profile in this repo — PROFILE_DIR lives outside it precisely so two people can share the
platform without sharing their job searches.
Validate with:  uv run python -m src.jobcore.profile validate
Summary for a skill prompt:  uv run python -m src.jobcore.profile --brief

identity.name: Jane Smith
identity._name: Used for outreach. The CV PDF filename is derived from the CV's own '# ' H1, not from here.

locale._timezone: IANA name. Dates a human reads are rendered in this zone, never bare UTC.
locale._languages: Drives the interview-prep query bank (e.g. local-language Glassdoor searches).

geo._mode: 'required' = a role outside the list is DROPPED before scoring. 'preferred' = kept and ranked. Start with 'preferred'; 'required' only makes sense with a real commute band.
geo._preferred_locations: Lowercase substrings matched against the job's location string.
geo._commute_extra: Per-ATS-target widening, e.g. {"some-defense-co": ["haifa"]} to allow one employer outside the band.

roles._target_titles: A title matching any of these is relevant regardless of the generic checks.
roles._above_band_titles: Ranked BELOW in-band roles, never dropped — title inflation varies wildly by company size.
roles._require_leadership: true only if you exclusively want lead/manager roles. An IC search must leave this false or everything scores 1.
roles._domain_exclusions: Hard drops. Only list domains you would never take.
roles._domain_exclusion_overrides: Rescues a false positive, e.g. 'embedded analytics' when 'embedded' is excluded.
roles._domain_label_exclusions: Optional. Department labels on a job board (e.g. 'R&D - Hardware') that mean 'not for me'. Empty = a built-in list for a SOFTWARE search (QA, hardware, HR, sales, finance...). A hardware, QA or sales candidate must set this, or their own field is dropped.
roles._depth_risk_titles: Optional. Title keywords for areas your CV is thinner on than your main strength (e.g. a backend lead might list 'data platform'). A match never filters or re-scores a role; the board just adds a depth advisory so you weight interview prep toward it. Empty = no opinion.

skills._keywords: Your actual stack. Each hit adds to the score — this is the main ranking signal.
skills._boost_keywords: The few that matter most; must be a subset of keywords.

facts._comment: GROUND TRUTH for the honesty gates. Leave empty and those gates SKIP (and say so) rather than silently pass. Fill it in and they can catch a CV overclaiming on your behalf.
facts._knockout_languages: Languages you do NOT have. A JD requiring one of these is flagged as a real gap.

employers.name: Acme Corp
employers._markers: Phrases that identify work done at THIS employer, so the gate can catch achievements attributed to the wrong job.

facts._never_claim: Technologies you must never appear to claim. The gate errors if the CV asserts one.
facts._rank_or_credential: e.g. a military rank or licence that must be stated exactly or not at all. null to disable.

privacy._comment: A FIREWALL for candidate-facing text (CV, cover letter, outreach). Anything listed here is scanned for before a draft is called clean. Typical entries: a pending legal or HR process, a former manager's name, an exact salary figure. Empty = no firewall configured (the profile brief says so); it is not 'all clear'.
privacy._private_dates: ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Each is matched in the forms people type: 2026-03-14, 14.3.2026, 14/3/2026, 'March 14', '14 March'.

salary._period: 'year' or 'month' — must match how your market quotes.

rag._comment: Study-note corpus for the retrieval gate. Globs resolve relative to PROFILE_DIR. Leave BOTH empty if you don't use the RAG lane; a corpus with no goldens makes the gate report SKIPPED (non-zero), never a vacuous PASS.

csv._comment: Your job-board export. `pattern` is a glob under the repo root; `sender_filter` keeps only rows whose sender column contains this substring ("" = keep every row).

research._comment: quick = 3 files (JD + snapshot + interview topics). deep = 6+ files, architecture diagrams, competitive analysis. deep costs materially more, so it is not the default.
